blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Jailbreak attempts and harmful prompts remain a challenge for the safe deployment of large language models. We study whether contrastively learned representations can support safety detection without training an additional downstream classifier. We propose Jailbreak Detection with Prototype Inference (JDPI), which uses binary safety labels to construct harmful and benign prototypes and makes predictions from relative prototype distances. JDPI uses only binary safety labels for encoder adaptation, prototype construction, and validation. In our setup, it uses fewer labeled examples than the classifier baseline (Method A) by avoiding the separate split used to train the downstream classifier. Across four benchmarks covering different input formats, contrastive fine-tuning improves JDPI's detection accuracy by 9.1-18.0 percentage points. Using the same encoder, JDPI achieves slightly higher ROC-AUC on one benchmark and stays within 0.017 of the baseline across all four. With dataset-specific adaptation, JDPI exceeds the released Llama Guard 3-8B baseline by 0.173-0.310 in ROC-AUC across the four benchmarks. In multi-turn replay on TomGibbs, JDPI uses accumulated user history as the conversation unfolds, achieving higher conversation-level accuracy than when it uses the current turn alone. Across 12 directed transfers, JDPI outperforms the classifier by an average of 1.59 percentage points in accuracy, demonstrating stronger cross-dataset robustness.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: For cybersecurity and safety, AI agents are typically deployed with policy constraints and safety guardrails. However, the increasing use of external tools and environments also introduces emerging security risks, including indirect prompt injection Zhan et al. (2024) , tool-integrated agent security Debenedetti et al. (2024) , and broader agent attack and defense scenarios Zhang et al. (2025a) . Despite these safeguards, security vulnerabilities and failure modes remain Perez et al. (2022) ; Chao et al. (2024) ; Mazeika et al. (2024) ; Ganguli et al. (2022) and so-called "jailbreaking" techniques are also commonly used to bypass safety alignment Wei et al. (2023) ; Zou et al. (2023) , which can pose risks to current AI-agent applications, starting from LLM use cases.
blocks.zh: 为了网络安全和安全,通常部署人工智能人员时有政策限制和安全护栏。 然而,越来越多地使用外部工具和环境也带来了新出现的安全风险,包括间接即时注射Zhan等人(2024年)、工具集成剂安全Debenedetti等人(2024年)以及更广泛的毒剂攻击和防御设想(2025a年)。 尽管有这些保障措施,但安全弱点和故障模式仍为Perez等人(2022年);Chao等人(2024年);Mazeika等人(2024年);Ganguli等人(2022年)和所谓的"破狱"技术也常用来绕过安全对接的Wei等人(2023年);Zou等人(2023年),从LLM使用案例开始,这些技术可能对目前的AI剂应用构成风险.

blocks.en: Many safety guards have been constructed at different levels. One commonly used tool is a classifier, which usually formulates safety detection as a classification problem Inan et al. (2023) ; Sharma et al. (2025) , and the workflow can be: first define or construct a series of policy-violating cases, and then train the classifier to detect whether an input or output is intended to trigger harmful content.
blocks.zh: 许多安全警卫已经在不同级别建造。 一个常用的工具是分类器,它通常将安全检测制定为分类问题Inan等人(2023年);Sharma等人(2025年),工作流程可以是:首先定义或构建出一系列具有政策活力的病例,然后训练分类器检测某项输入或输出是否意在触发有害内容.

blocks.en: The problem arises from this setup itself: first, the taxonomies are usually designed according to predefined safety policies or risk categories Mazeika et al. (2024) ; Markov et al. (2023) and may not fully cover all cases. Second, attention may be directed toward distinguishing detailed categories rather than the underlying intent of the context itself. Third, the boundaries between detailed categories can be fuzzy and may not correspond directly to the structure of the representation space Inan et al. (2023) ; Sharma et al. (2025) ; Galinkin and Sablotny (2024) . This motivates the question of whether harmful and benign inputs also form exploitable geometric structures in the learned representation space. If such structure exists, it raises two related questions: whether representation-aware structural features can improve conventional classifiers, and whether the classification process can be replaced by direct geometric inference based on the learned representation geometry.
blocks.zh: 问题出自这种设置本身:第一,分类法通常按照预先确定的安全政策或风险类别Mazeika等人(2024年);Markov等人(2023年)来设计,可能不能完全涵盖所有案例. 第二,不妨注意区分详细的类别,而不是背景本身的基本意图。 第三,详细类别之间的界限可能模糊不清,可能与代表空间Inan等人(2023年);Sharma等人(2025年);Galinkin和Sablotny(2024年)的结构不直接对应. 这引发了这样一个问题,即有害和良性的投入是否在已学到的表示空间中也形成可被利用的几何结构。 如果这种结构存在,它提出了两个相关的问题:表示-意识结构特征是否能够改进常规分类器,分类过程是否能够被基于所学的表示几何学的直接几何推论所取而代之.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: A wide range of defense mechanisms has been proposed to improve LLM safety. Some methods enhance safety by prioritizing higher-level instructions over lower-level instructions during inference Wallace et al. (2024) , while others train models to reason about explicit safety specifications before generating responses Guan et al. (2025) . Robustness has also been improved through adversarial training and the incorporation of adversarial objectives Sheshadri et al. (2025) . Additional approaches intervene directly at the representation or activation level through mechanisms such as representation rerouting Zou et al. (2024) . Traditional defense strategies, including input detection, preprocessing, and adversarial training, have also been systematically evaluated Jain et al. (2023) . Input perturbation methods have also been explored, such as SmoothLLM Robey et al. (2024) . Other work investigates internal hidden-layer representations and performs layer-wise safety analysis followed by binary classification Kadali and Papalexakis (2026) . Classifier-based detection is also widely used in safety guard systems Inan et al. (2023) ; Sharma et al. (2025) . Embedding-based jailbreak detectors have combined pretrained sentence representations with conventional classifiers Galinkin and Sablotny (2024) . Despite these advances, many widely used guard models are constructed around predefined safety policies, risk categories, or labeled safety datasets. However, generalization to emerging attack strategies and previously unseen harmful behaviors remains a challenge. Furthermore, the opposite failure mode, namely over-refusal of benign inputs, has received increasing attention and has been studied explicitly in recent work Cui et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 为改善LLM安全性,提出了广泛的防御机制. 一些方法通过在推论Wallace等人(2024年)中优先考虑更高层次的指令而不是更低层次的指令来增强安全性,而其他方法则在生成响应Guan等人(2025年)之前训练模型以说明明确的安全规格. 通过对抗训练和纳入对抗目标,Sheshadri等人(2025年)也提高了自强性。 其他办法通过代表改道等机制在代表一级直接干预或激活(2024年)。 传统的防御战略,包括输入检测、预处理和对抗训练,也得到了系统的评价Jain等人(2023年)。 还探讨了输入扰动方法,如平滑LLM Robey等人(2024年)。 其他工作调查内部隐藏层的表示,进行分层安全分析,然后是二进制分类Kadali和Papalexakis(2026年)。 基于分级器的检测也被广泛用于安全警卫系统Inan等人 (2023年); Sharma等人 (2025年). 嵌入式越狱侦测器与常规分类器Galinkin和Sablotny(2024年)结合了预先训练的刑期表述. 尽管取得了这些进展,许多广泛使用的警卫模型还是围绕预先确定的安全政策,风险类别,或贴有标签的安全数据集来构建. 然而,对新出现的攻击策略和以前所未见的有害行为的概括仍然是一个挑战。 此外,相反的失败模式,即过度拒绝良性投入,也日益受到关注,最近的工作Cui等人(2025年)对此进行了明确研究。

blocks.en: To determine whether latent representations contain meaningful safety signals, several studies have investigated safety-related information encoded within internal model states Ball et al. (2024) ; Jin et al. (2024) . JBShield identifies activated safety-related concepts in internal representations and leverages them for jailbreak detection and mitigation Zhang et al. (2025b) . SIREN further exploits internal safety-relevant features distributed across model layers for harmful-content detection Jiao et al. (2026) . RCS similarly performs jailbreak detection through representational contrastive scoring in latent space Hua et al. (2026) . Collectively, these studies suggest that internal representations contain rich geometric and semantic information that can be effectively leveraged for safety assessment.
blocks.zh: 为了确定潜在表示是否包含有意义的安全信号,一些研究调查了内部模型国家Ball等人(2024年);Jin等人(2024年)编码的安全相关信息。 JBShield在内部表述中识别了激活的安全相关概念,并将其用于越狱侦查和缓解张等 (2025b). . SIREN进一步利用分布在模型层的内部安全相关特征来进行有害内容检测 Jiao等 (2026). RCS同样通过潜在空间Hua等人(2026年)的表征对比分来进行越狱检测。 这些研究表明,内部表述包含丰富的几何和语义信息,可以有效地用于安全评估。

blocks.en: A growing number of benchmarks evaluate jailbreak and safety-related behavior using large collections of adversarial and red-teaming-derived inputs, covering both harmful and benign requests. Many of these benchmarks provide comprehensive collections of both harmful and benign prompts, Shen et al. (2024) collect and analyze in-the-wild jailbreak prompts, characterizing their attack strategies and evaluating their effectiveness against LLMs and external safeguards. WildJailbreak and WildGuardMix contain vanilla and adversarial prompts covering harmful and benign requests, including synthetic adversarial prompts generated using tactics mined from in-the-wild interactions Jiang et al. (2024) ; Han et al. (2024) . BeaverTails provides question–answer pairs derived from red-teaming-related prompts designed to elicit unsafe responses, with safety annotations defined over the complete QA pair Ji et al. (2023) . Gibbs et al. (2024) introduce paired single-turn and multi-turn cipher-based jailbreak inputs, alongside benign controls, and examine how prompting structure and conversational context affect guardrail performance. Evaluation frameworks such as StrongREJECT further emphasize that jailbreak assessment should account for whether harmful behavior is actually elicited rather than only whether an attack prompt is present Souly et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: 越来越多的基准评估越狱和安全相关行为,利用大量收集的对抗和红色小组产生的投入,涵盖有害和良性的请求。 其中许多基准提供了有害和良性诱因的综合收集,Shen等人。 (2024) 收集和分析越狱事件,描述其攻击战略,评估其针对法学硕士和外部保障的有效性。 WildJailbreak和WildGuardMix含有香草和对抗性提示,包括有害和良性的请求,包括利用从 " 万能互动 " 中挖掘出来的战术产生的合成对抗性提示(2024年);Han等人(2024年)。 BeaverTails提供来自红色小组相关提示的问答对子,旨在得到不安全的响应,安全说明在完整的QA对Ji等(2023年)上被定义. Gibbs等人(2024年)在良性控制的同时,引入了对接的单转和多转接接的密码式的越狱输入,并研究了触发结构和对话背景如何影响护轨性能. StrongREJECT等评价框架还进一步强调,越狱评估应说明是否确实引发了有害行为,而不应仅仅说明是否出现了Souly等人(2024年)的袭击。

blocks.en: Contrastive learning Chen et al. (2020) improves representation structure by increasing the separation between semantically different samples. This principle has been applied to sentence representation learning Gao et al. (2022) and supervised class-aware representation learning Khosla et al. (2021) . Sentence-transformer models provide fixed-dimensional sentence representations that are suitable for efficient similarity and distance computation Reimers and Gurevych (2019) , extending pretrained Transformer encoders such as BERT Devlin et al. (2019) . In our work, an MPNet-based sentence-transformer encoder is used to obtain semantic representations for subsequent structure analysis Song et al. (2020) .
blocks.zh: 相互矛盾的学习 Chen等 (2020年)通过增加不同标本之间的分化,改善了代表结构. 这一原则适用于对Gao等人(2022年)和受监督的班级认知代表学习Khosla等人(2021年)的判决。 句子转换模型提供了适合高效相似性和距离计算Reimers和Gurevich(2019)的固定维度句子表示法,扩展了BERT Devlin等预先训练的变形器编码器(2019). 在我们的作品中,一个基于MPNet的句子转换编码器用于获取语义表达,用于后续的结构分析 Song等 (2020年).

blocks.en: Prototypical Networks introduced prototype-based few-shot classification, where samples are classified according to distances from representative class prototypes in a learned metric space Snell et al. (2017) . Prototype-oriented Conditional Transport Tanwisuth et al. (2021) addresses source–target alignment by aligning target features with class prototypes. Recent safety detection methods have similarly explored geometric signals in representation space. RCS distinguishes benign and malicious inputs through contrastive scoring over internal model representations Hua et al. (2026) , while T3 models the distribution of acceptable prompts in semantic space and formulates safety detection as out-of-distribution detection without requiring harmful training examples Ganguly et al. (2026) . The Semantic Codebooks approach compares multilingual query embeddings against a fixed codebook of jailbreak prompts, providing a training-free external guardrail based on semantic similarity Alanova et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 原型网络引入了以原型为主的几发分级,在所学的度量空间Snell等人(2017年)中,样本按照与代表性分级原型相距的距离进行分级. 以原型为导向的"条件运输"(Contentional Transport Tanwisuth等 (2021))通过将目标特征与类原型相配合,解决了源-目标对接问题. 最近的安全探测方法同样探索了代表空间中的几何信号. RCS通过对比性评分与内部模型代表Hua等人(2026年)区分出良性与恶意输入,而T3模型则在语义空间中分配可接受的提示并形成安全检测为分流外检测而不需要有害的培训实例Ganguly等人(2026年). 语义法典方法将多语种的查询嵌入与固定的"越狱提示"的代码手册相提并论,根据语义相似性Alanova等(2026年)提供无培训外护栏.

blocks.en: Different from these approaches, our focus is not to construct a stronger embedding model or to model only a predefined safe or malicious reference distribution. Instead, we investigate whether geometric structure learned under binary harmful benign supervision can reduce the dependence on an additional downstream classifier. Using the same contrastively adapted encoder, we compare embedding-based classification and variants augmented with clustering-derived features against direct inference from harmful and benign prototype sets, without requiring fine-grained risk annotations. But how finer cluster structure and its refinement affect binary harmful–benign detection is still examined.
blocks.zh: 与这些方法不同,我们的重点不是构建更强大的嵌入模型,也不是只构建一个预先定义的安全或恶意的参考分布模型。 相反,我们调查在二进制有害良性监督下获得的几何结构是否能够减少对下游额外分类器的依赖。 我们使用相同的对比性调整编码器,比较了嵌入式分类和以集群衍生特征为补充的变种,与由有害和良性原型组直接推论,而不需要细微的风险说明。 但更精细的集群结构及其完善如何影响二进制有害-原生检测仍在研究之中.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: The proposed framework consists of two main stages. First, contrastive representation learning is employed to increase the separation between harmful and benign inputs in the embedding space, thereby inducing a safety-aware geometric structure. Second, the resulting representation space is exploited for downstream detection through a series of increasingly structure-aware approaches, ranging from conventional classifier-based methods to direct prototype-based inference. Figure 1 provides an overview of the framework.
blocks.zh: 拟议框架由两个主要阶段组成。 首先,采用对比性表现学习方法来增加嵌入空间中有害和良性投入之间的分化,从而诱发安全意识几何结构. 第二,利用由此产生的代表空间进行下游探测,通过一系列越来越了解结构的方法,从基于常规分类器的方法到基于原型的直接推断。 图1概述了该框架。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and Splits
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和分割

blocks.en: We evaluate safety detection on four benchmarks using individual prompts, question–answer pairs, and multi-turn conversations. The evaluation includes adversarial prompts from WildGuardMix and WildJailbreak and multi-turn jailbreak attempts from TomGibbs. Class proportions below refer to our experimental test splits. We abbreviate WildGuardMix, WildJailbreak, BeaverTailsQA, and TomGibbs as WGM, WJB, BTQA, and TG, respectively. We derive the binary safety labels from the released annotations or categories of each benchmark and match the unit of evaluation to the unit those labels describe.
blocks.zh: 我们用单个提示、问答对等和多回合对话来评估四个基准的安全检测。 包括来自WildGuardMix和WildJailbreak的对抗性提示以及TomGibbs的多回合越狱尝试。 下级比例是指我们的实验测试分出. 我们分别将WildGuardMix,WildJailbreak,BeaverTailsQA和TomGibbs简称为WGM,WJB,BTQA和TG. 我们从每个基准的发布说明或类别中得出二进制安全标签,并将评价单位与这些标签描述的单位相匹配。

blocks.en:
WildGuardMix Han et al. (2024) contains vanilla and adversarial prompts with harmful and benign labels.
We use the prompt text and its prompt-harmfulness annotation. The test split contains 53.10% harmful and 46.90% benign prompts.
blocks.zh:
野外守护 混合 韩等. (2024年)包含有有害和良性标签的香草和对抗性提示.
我们使用即时文本及其即时的和谐说明。 测试分解包含53.10%的有害和46.90%的良性活泼.

blocks.en:
WildJailbreak Jiang et al. (2024) contains vanilla and adversarial versions of harmful and benign requests, including benign prompts that resemble attacks but have no harmful intent.
Our classifier-training split combines 30,000 vanilla and 6,000 adversarial examples; the structure, validation, and test splits contain adversarial examples. The test split contains 51.77% harmful and 48.23% benign prompts.
blocks.zh:
狂欢 Jiang等人(2024年)载有有害和良性请求的香草和对抗性版本,包括类似攻击但没有有害意图的良性提示.
我们的分类-训练分拆结合了30,000个香草和6,000个对抗性的例子;结构,验证和测试分拆包含对抗性的例子. 测试分拆包含51.77%的有害和48.23%的良性提示.

blocks.en: BeaverTails Ji et al. (2023) provides a safety label for each question–answer pair. The label depends on the answer in the context of the question, so the same question can receive different labels when paired with different answers. We therefore concatenate the user question and the assistant response as a single input. Unsafe pairs are mapped to the harmful class and safe pairs to the benign class, accounting for 55.42% and 44.58% of the test split, respectively.
blocks.zh: BeaverTails Ji等人(2023年)为每对问答提供了安全标签。 标签取决于问题上下文中的答案,因此,当与不同的答案对齐时,同一个问题可以得到不同的标签. 因此,我们将用户问题和助理答复合并为单一输入。 不安全的对子被映射到有害的类上,安全对子被映射到良性类上,分别占试验分数的55.42%和44.58%.

blocks.en: We use the input-only Multi-Turn Jailbreak Attack Datasets of Gibbs et al. (2024) . Each example provides a complete single-turn prompt and a corresponding sequence of user turns. The attacks use word-substitution ciphers and distribute their instructions across turns.
blocks.zh: 我们只使用Gibbs等人(2024年)的多透关攻击数据集。 每个例子都提供了完整的单转快取和相应的用户转动顺序. 攻击使用文字替代密码,并在各回合间分发指示.

blocks.en: The dataset includes harmful, completely benign, and semi-benign examples. Semi-benign examples contain harmful or toxic vocabulary but pursue benign goals; both benign subsets are assigned label 0. These three groups account for 63.39%, 18.75%, and 17.86% of our test split, respectively. For the separate static evaluation, we use the corresponding complete prompts from the same held-out examples.
blocks.zh: 数据集包括有害的,完全良性的,半原始的例子. 半原始实例包含有害或有毒词汇,但追求良性目标;两个良性子集被指定为标签 零点 这三个组分别占我们测试分数的63.39%、18.75%和17.86%。 对于单独的静态评价,我们使用同一搁置实例中相应的完整提示.

blocks.en: We divide each dataset into four splits. The structure split is used to fine-tune the encoder and construct clusters and class prototypes. The training split supplies the labeled examples for fitting the downstream classifiers. We use the validation split to select detector settings, including decision thresholds. The test split is held out throughout model development and used only for final evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们把每套数据分成四分 结构分解用于微调编码器并构建集群和类原型. 培训的分解提供了标有标签的例子,以适应下游的分类。 我们使用验证分解来选择检测器设置,包括决定阈值. 测试划分在整个模型开发过程中进行,仅用于最后评价。

blocks.en: For WildGuardMix and BeaverTailsQA, we pool the released training and test partitions, sample 60,000 examples stratified by the binary label, and construct new experimental splits. For TomGibbs, we assign entire goal groups to splits and downsample the training and structure splits to balance the binary labels. Table 1 summarizes the split sizes.

blocks.en: 4.2 Baselines and Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.2 基线和评价计量

blocks.en:
We compare JDPI with an embedding-based classifier (Method A)
using the same encoder. Methods B–D provide additional comparisons using structure-derived features. Llama Guard 3-8B serves as an external baseline without task-specific fine-tuning. We report accuracy and ROC-AUC, supplemented by F1, false-negative rate, and false-positive rate. We also report silhouette scores to characterize harmful–benign separation and clustering structure within the harmful class.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This paper investigates how the structure of learned representations can support jailbreak and harmful-input detection. We examine two related questions: whether explicit structural information improves a conventional embedding-based classifier, and whether the learned geometry can support detection without training an additional downstream classifier.
blocks.zh: 本文调查了学习到的陈述结构如何能支持越狱和有害输入的检测. 我们研究两个相关的问题:明确的结构信息是否改进了传统的嵌入式分类器,以及所学几何学能否支持检测,而不培训额外的下游分类器.

blocks.en: Contrastive fine-tuning improves the separation between harmful and benign examples in the embedding space, providing a clearer structure for constructing class prototypes. It also improves JDPI’s detection accuracy across all four benchmarks. The clustering-derived features in Methods B–D yield small, dataset-dependent gains in the in-domain experiments. This suggests that classifier A already captures much of the signal needed for detection directly from the fine-tuned embeddings. On WildGuardMix, WildJailbreak, and BeaverTailsQA, JDPI achieves accuracy close to that of classifier A while saving the labeled data and computation required to train a downstream classifier. With dataset-specific adaptation, JDPI exceeds the released Llama Guard 3-8B baseline in accuracy and ROC-AUC on all four benchmarks. Together, these results support representation adaptation as a basis for effective detection with a simple downstream decision rule.
blocks.zh: 相矛盾的微调改善了嵌入空间中有害和良性例子的分离,为构建类原型提供了更清晰的结构. 这也提高了JDPI在所有四个基准的检测精度. 方法B-D中的集群特征在域内实验中产生依赖数据集的小型收益。 这表明分类器A已经直接从微调嵌入物中捕捉出检测所需的大部分信号. 在"WildGuardMix","WildJailbreak"和"BeaverTailsQA"上,JDPI实现了接近分类器A的精度,同时保存了为训练下游分类器而需要的被标注的数据和计算. 随着数据集的特异性调整,JDPI准确性超过了发布的Llama Guard 3-8B基线,在所有四个基准上都超过了ROC-AUC. 这些结果加在一起,支持了代表性的调整,以此作为以简单的下游决定规则进行有效检测的基础。

Together, these results show that contrastively adapted representations can support competitive prototype-based detection. JDPI uses binary safety labels for encoder adaptation, prototype construction, and validation. JDPI avoids the separate labeled split used to train classifier A and shows greater robustness to dataset shift as measured by mean accuracy across the evaluated transfers.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Although JDPI removes the need for a trained downstream classifier, binary labels are still required for contrastive representation learning, class-specific prototype construction, and validation-based parameter selection. In our experimental setup, it avoids the additional labeled training split used by the classifier, but does not eliminate dependence on labeled data.
blocks.zh: 虽然JDPI取消了对训练有素的下游分级器的需求,但对比性表现学习,类特异性原型构建,以及基于验证的参数选择仍然需要二进制标签. 在我们的实验设置中,它避免了分类器使用的附加被标记的训练分拆,但并没有消除对被标记数据的依赖.

blocks.en: How larger fine-tuning datasets or greater encoder training budgets affect the relative performance of JDPI and the classifier baseline remains an open question. Although the decision threshold and temperature of JDPI are selected on the validation split, the search covers a finite set of candidate values. Sensitivity to these parameters, training duration, clustering configurations, and distance metrics has not been fully characterized.
blocks.zh: 更大的微调数据集或更大的编码器培训预算如何影响JDPI的相对性能,分类器基线仍然是一个未决问题. 虽然JDPI的决定阈值和温度是在验证分出时选择的,但搜索涵盖了一组有限的候选值. 对这些参数的敏感性、培训期限、集群配置和距离度量标准尚未完全确定。

blocks.en: Cross-dataset experiments show that transfer performance varies across source–target pairs and involves different false-positive and false-negative trade-offs.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 5 , the fine-tuned embedding model benefits not only prototype-based detection but also produces a clear improvement for the baseline classifier. blocks.en: Contrastive fine-tuning improves JDPI across all four benchmarks. Its accuracy increases by 14.81 percentage points on WildGuardMix, 16.54 on WildJailbreak, 9.14 on BeaverTailsQA, and 17.97 on TomGibbs. Classifier A also improves, with accuracy gains ranging from 3.75 to 12.59 percentage points.

blocks.en:
The larger gains for JDPI suggest that contrastive adaptation makes the representation geometry more useful for direct prototype-based decisions.
In particular, E approaches A on WildGuardMix and WildJailbreak after fine-tuning. The resulting performance therefore depends on the combination of representation learning and prototype inference, rather than on prototype construction alone.

blocks.en: Appendix D Ablation Study: Harmful-Subcluster Refinement
blocks.zh: 附录D 研究:有害-子集群

blocks.en:
In the second phase, we further refine the internal structure of the harmful representations through an iterative clustering procedure. At each iteration, harmful samples are re-encoded using the current encoder and partitioned using K K -means clustering. The number of clusters is selected from K = 4 , … , 12 K=4,\ldots,12 by maximizing the silhouette score computed using cosine distance.
The resulting cluster assignments are used as pseudo-labels to construct new contrastive pairs. Harmful samples belonging to the same cluster form positive pairs, while harmful samples from different clusters form negative pairs. Harmful-benign pairs are additionally retained as negative pairs to preserve the global separation between the two classes.
blocks.zh:
在第二阶段,我们通过迭接分组程序来进一步完善有害表述的内部结构。 在每次迭代时,使用当前编码器对有害样品进行再编码,并使用K-表示集群进行分化. 组数从 K = 4,., 12 K = 4,\ ldots,12 中选择,通过最大分数使用相弦距离计算。
由此产生的集群任务被作为伪标签来构建出新的对比性对. 属于同一组的有害样品形成正对,而来自不同组群的有害样品形成负对. 有害-原生对被作为负对再保留,以保持两类之间的全球分化.

blocks.en:
Using these newly constructed pairs, the encoder is further optimized with the same CoSENTLoss. The updated encoder is then used to re-encode harmful samples, and the clustering process is repeated for up to a predefined maximum number of iterations.
By progressively refining substructures within the harmful class, this stage allows us to examine whether finer cluster separation improves binary harmful–benign detection.
blocks.zh:
利用这些新构造的对子,编码器被同为CoSENTLOS进一步优化. 然后使用更新的编码器来重新编码有害样品,集群过程被重复到最多一个预定义的最大重复次数.
通过逐步完善有害类的子结构,这一阶段使我们能够审查更精细的集群分离是否改善了二元有害-原物检测。
